recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is recommended for FHIR-26635; reintroducing characterization or HPLC under structure.technique would conflict with the later FHIR-39596 decision.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive R5 BRR change request to rename SubstanceDefinition.Structure.sourceCoding to Structure.technique and define it as the method used to elucidate the structure or characterization of the drug substance, with examples such as X-ray, HPLC, NMR, peptide mapping, and ligand binding assay.
initial_application: Git commit 3885120c62 explicitly applied FHIR-26635 in the old SubstanceDefinition spreadsheet by renaming SubstanceDefinition.structure.sourceCoding to SubstanceDefinition.structure.technique and replacing the old source-of-information definition with technique wording and examples. Later source refactoring carried the element into the current XML StructureDefinition.

Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue FHIR-39596 separated characterization details into SubstanceDefinition.characterization, removed HPLC from the structure technique terminology, and is already represented on the combined branch by commit 670d087b4d.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current build input contains SubstanceDefinition.structure.technique with the structure technique value set, contains no SubstanceDefinition.structure.sourceCoding residue, and preserves the later separation between structure and characterization terminology.
